posts.author: Another Fen
posts.body:
Adding some detail to the "avoiding the interpreter" point, one issue with your opening code is that the default message implementation does not allow you to line up another message before the previous one is fully completed and cleared (which has technically not yet happened when the choice is recorded). Similarly, the "setWaitMode" function does not immediately interrupt your script command. The command will be fully executed, but the interpreter will not start executing another before the wait is completed.
As a result, the easiest solution would probably be to split your script command into multiple parts, adding a break whenever you want the event to wait for the previous step to complete.
(You may have to save some data from your local variables in a way that they are accessible by the later script parts)
Of course, that is if you want to stick to the scripted event approach.
